## Summary

Describe the user-visible problem and the smallest coherent change.

## Validation

- [ ] Focused compiler/runtime tests pass.
- [ ] JAX output or gradient correctness was checked where applicable.
- [ ] Performance claims disclose the full measurement configuration.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, weights, or customer data are included.
- [ ] Third-party changes update their source overlay and locked tree/checksum.
- [ ] Commits include a Developer Certificate of Origin sign-off.

## Upstream relationship

State whether the change is fork-specific, already upstream, or a candidate for
an upstream IREE/LLVM/SPIRV-Cross/StableHLO contribution.
